notablePrerequisites: You have the City's Blessing or have at least eight permanents on the battlefield.
description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla; pay {1} to make a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the token Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning the original Timestream Navigator to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
